L9·N1411unmasked layer
Rather than a clean lexical trigger, this unit tracks how (un)expected the current token is given the local phrase: it fires on tokens that are surprising completions of a collocation/compound (e.g. " CPU" after a chipset name, "met" in "Grommet", "angle" in "Spangle", " rather" in "by ions rather than"), and is strongly suppressed on highly predictable completions or verbatim repeats ("holster…holster", "post office", "helipad", "their dogs").
